hud.wallis_ultimate.downed.title: You're down!
menu.wallis_ultimate.disclaimer: Wallis Ultimate is a work of fiction. All characters, names and events are fictional. Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, is coincidental or intended as parody.
message.wallis_ultimate.bed.already_have: You already have a bed on this planet, at %s, %s, %s. Pick that one up first.
message.wallis_ultimate.grave.location: Your things are in your grave at %s, %s, %s. It lasts 60 minutes.
message.wallis_ultimate.safe_spot.found: You found a safe spot: %s. Its signpost connects it to the others you know.
message.wallis_ultimate.safe_spot.protec: Best leave this place the way it is.
message.wallis_ultimate.travel.in_combat: Not in the middle of a fight!
screen.wallis_ultimate.travel.none: You don't know any other safe spots yet.
screen.wallis_ultimate.travel.title: Where to?
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.al: Then again, he's been green since that thing with the gas station sushi.
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.bo: Nobody remembers days one through eight. Somebody's boot is in the still. Somebody's foot is in the boot. Best batch yet.
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.ca: You raise a can. He raises an arm. The arm falls off. Classic Darryl.
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.da: Here comes Darryl, back from the outhouse. Darryl looks like shit.
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.we: Day nine of what you dumb sons of bitches still call a quiet weekend.
story.wallis_ultimate.caption.opening.wh: Somebody just shot Darryl's head clean off. Rude. He owed you twenty bucks.
story.wallis_ultimate.conversation.title: Conversation
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.carl.subtitl: Don't let him start on the chickens. For the love of God.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.carl.text1: Lurleen: "There's a fella at Camp Tarp who won't shut the fuck up on the CB. Carl. Every corpse in the county can hear him. Go tell him to turn it down."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.carl.text2: Camp Tarp is east of the cabin. You'll hear him before you see him. You'll smell him before that.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.carl.title: Turn It Down, Carl
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.dinner.subti: You can't live on beer and raw squirrel.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.dinner.task: Have some cooked food on you
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.dinner.text1: Lurleen: "Well, you have been, and look at the shits it gave you. I could hear you from two hollers over. Cook somethin'. Anything. One hot meal and I'll show you Granny's kitchen tricks."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.dinner.text2: A furnace or a campfire will do. Darryl's mama doesn't count, we checked.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.dinner.title: Hot Meal
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.file: Lurleen's List of Shit To Do
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.hog.subtitle: He only ever had the one boot.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.hog.text1: It's Old Man Hogg, or it used to be. It's through the wall, it's headed for his farm, and it's angrier than you and a whole lot fatter. Run, then fight it in the pen: make it charge into something solid, and hit it while it's stunned. Try fire. Everybody likes bacon.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.hog.title: Hog Daddy
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.home.subtitl: Before dark, shithead. She's not kiddin'.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.home.text1: Lurleen handed everyone a bed. She took them off the Hendersons, who aren't using them. One of them still has some Henderson on it. Nights out here will kill you: by day they're slow, by dark they're not.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.home.text2: Pick a spot, put your bed down, get a roof over it. That's home now, God help it, and Lurleen will move in.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.home.title: Create First Home
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.intro.subtit: The world ended. Y'all missed it, you useless bastards.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.intro.text1: Some woman with a shotgun says the world ended a week ago. She also says it wasn't Darryl. She also said a lot of things about you and your mother, and they were all fair.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.intro.text2: She wrote you a list. This is the list. Don't wipe with it.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.intro.title: Mornin', Sunshine
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.night.subtit: First night in your own bed. Mr. Henderson's got opinions.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.night.text1: Lurleen: "You ain't made it through a night yet, not sober. Sleep one off in your own bed. Come mornin', I got somethin' for you, and it ain't what you're hopin', Cletus."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.night.text2: It's Granny's Rabbit Foot, one for each of you. Wear it as a charm. At night it makes things a little fairer. It also smells like a pickle jar, because it's been in one since before you were born.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.night.title: Sleep It Off
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.radio.subtit: There's a smug asshole on Darryl's radio.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.radio.text1: Lurleen: "Darryl's old radio's still sittin' in the cabin. Go see if there's anybody left to talk to who ain't you."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.radio.text2: It's on the drawers at the back of the cabin. Right-click to listen. You'll wish you hadn't.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.radio.title: The Bunker Experience
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.ready.subtit: Old Man Hogg's place went quiet. The smell didn't.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.ready.task: Tell Lurleen you're ready, at the cabin
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.ready.text1: Lurleen: "Hogs ain't hollerin'. And somethin's been goin' round and round the old cabin at night, shittin' like a dump truck. Folks called him Hog Daddy, back when that was funny."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.ready.text2: Get your best gear and your whole crew. When you're ready, talk to Lurleen at the old cabin. Once it starts, it doesn't stop, so piss first.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.ready.title: Tracks Big as a Washtub
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.safe.subtitl: Earl's Salvage, Gas-N-Guns, Camp Tarp, the Stranded Hauler.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.safe.text1: That smug asshole on the radio says there are safe spots out there: north, west, east and south of the cabin. They've got walls, they've got beds, and they know how to work metal. They don't know you yet, so you've got a shot.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.safe.text2: Find any one of them. Whatever they teach you about smelting, you'll keep. A safe spot's signpost connects it to the others you've found.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.safe.title: Folks With Walls
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.scrap.subtit: Copper first, then iron, you lump.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.scrap.text1: Lurleen: "So now you can melt shit. Copper first, then iron. Bring home eight bars of iron and I'll show you what a skillet's really for."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.scrap.text2: Copper ore needs a stone pickaxe. Iron ore needs a copper one. Licking it doesn't help. Somebody tried.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.scrap.title: Eight Bars
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.swing.subtit: A beer can ain't a weapon, no matter what happened at Cousin Ray's wedding.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.swing.text1: Lurleen: "You can't fight nothin' with a can. Cabin's got a crafting table. Make a stone sword, and if you don't cut your own dick off, I'll show you what else you can put nails in."
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.swing.title: Somethin' to Swing
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.zombies.subt: Aim for the head. It's the only part they ain't usin'.
story.wallis_ultimate.quest.zombies.text: Lurleen: "Don't let three get around you. They get fast in the dark, and they hear loud shit from a long way off. Go put down five, and try not to recognize any of 'em. You owe most of 'em money."
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_again.wa: Still human? Good. Don't drink out of the reservoir. I ain't sayin' why. I don't know why. But they're real fuckin' interested in it, and I drank out of it once, and my piss came out blue.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.be: You do? Nobody ever... Huh. Well, you're either the smartest son of a bitch left alive or the stupidest. Keep your water boiled and your eyes on the sky.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.bo: That's EXACTLY what one of them would say to throw me off. Which means you ain't one. Either that or you're the dumbest goddamn alien in the whole goddamn fleet.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.ch: And the chickens. I ain't sayin' more about the chickens. You go look one in the eye, then you tell me that's from around here. I looked. I ain't had a solid shit since.
You've got a pie tin on your head.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.cl: Think, you dumb shit! Who gains? Not the dead. Not the Army. I seen folks out by the reservoir at night, in robes, with a clipboard. Who the hell brings a clipboard to a lake?
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.hu: ...Okay. Okay, yeah, that's real human. Real shitty, too. Lurleen send you? Tell that flannel-wearin' bitch I ain't turnin' the CB down.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.la: You think this came out of some Army lab? The Army couldn't keep a lid on a chili cook-off. This ain't from here. It's ALIENS, man. I been tellin' people for years. They keep checkin' my medication.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.st: STOP right there, fuckface! Say somethin' only a human would say.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.carl_first.ti: It's FOIL, asshole. A pie tin don't block shit. Go on, laugh it up. Keep your water boiled and your eyes on the sky.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_again: You still got legs, that's somethin'. That big bastard ain't done, and neither are you. Go again?
That's the spirit. Dumb as a bag of hammers, but that's the spirit.
Take your time. I'm sure it won't eat nobody else. Oh, wait.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_bante: Don't go lookin' for the Army. They ain't lookin' for you, and they shoot a hell of a lot straighter than you piss.
One of you shit in the rain barrel. I ain't askin' who. I'm just tellin' you that's what you been drinkin'.
No, I will not hold your beer. There ain't no beer. Quit lookin' at me like I shit in your last can.
You believed Carl. Bless your heart, you dumb son of a bitch. That man once tried to sell me a horse, said it was a spy. It was just a real judgmental horse.
You ever see a skinny fool with a dip ring wore into his back pocket and his fly open, you tell me. That's Dale. That's my idiot. These here are just the local ones.
Aliens. Sure. That man once tried to sell me a horse, said it was a spy. Then he ate it, when it wouldn't talk.
Eyes up, Cletus. The knot ain't goin' anywhere, and neither are you if you keep that up.
Granny would've had y'all sorted by now. Granny's dead, and she'd still have y'all sorted. She'd have done it with a spoon.
I've seen better-lookin' things crawl out of a septic tank. One of 'em's my ex, and he had better manners.
You smell that? That's you. And I've been downwind of a dead mule.
If you're gonna die, do it outside. I just swept, and you people bleed like stuck hogs.
There's a fella at Camp Tarp who won't shut the fuck up on the CB. Carl. Every corpse in the county can hear him. Go tell him to turn it down, and for Christ's sake don't let him start on the chickens.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_dinne: You can't live on beer and raw squirrel. Well, you have been, and look at the shits it gave you. I could hear you from two hollers over. Cook somethin'. Anything. One hot meal and I'll show you Granny's kitchen tricks.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_endin: ...I hate that I checked. There ain't. Now shut your damn mouth, radio's goin'.
A bite don't do that. A bite don't make a man ten foot tall with a gut like that and a hook for a hand. Somethin' else got into him, and I don't know what. And I've seen what that man ate.
That was Old Man Hogg. That's his boot. He only ever had the one. Lost the other in the wood chipper, along with what he called his good foot.
Carl thinks his toaster's listenin'. Carl once tried to arrest a goose. Now shut your damn mouth, radio's goin'.
No. Get some real walls up, and do it quick. Whatever that was, it was just the fuckin' neighbors. This ain't our land no more.

...anybody out there? It's your boy in the bunker. Bad news, bros. Raiders up on the highway, takin' whatever's left and whoever's left. And I got folks callin' in about people in robes, out by the reservoir. Fencin' it off. Nobody knows what the fuck they want.
Lot of rabbits, Cletus. Not much luck for them. Jar's still good for pickles, if you're hungry.
Last week was a bad night. She took four of 'em with her, and one of 'em with her dentures.

Still breathin'? Damn, I lost a bet. Here. Granny raised rabbits. Ate 'em, skinned 'em, kept the feet in a pickle jar. Eighty-one years and never one bad night. They only work after dark, don't ask me why.
Isn't that a lot of feet?
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_hog.s: Y'all smell that? Worse than you, I mean. Old Man Hogg's place went quiet three days back. Hogs ain't hollerin'. And I found tracks big as a washtub, goin' round and round the old cabin, and a pile of shit I could park a truck in. Folks called him Hog Daddy, back when that was funny. Get your best gear and your whole crew. When you're ready, meet me at the cabin.
Sun don't wait, shitheads. Pick a spot, put a bed down, get a roof over it. I ain't sleepin' outside with you dumbasses, and neither are you, on account of you'd be dead.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_intro: And the Hendersons ain't usin' their beds no more. Take one. Mr. Henderson's still in it, so shake him out first. Put it under a roof before dark. By day they're slow and they cook in the sun. By night they ain't, and you're the cook-out.
There ain't more anything, Cletus. That's what I came all the way up here to tell you, and I'm already sorry I did.
Lord. I was hopin' it was the moonshine that made you this stupid. Turns out the moonshine's been carryin' you.
Now get. Day's burnin', and so's Darryl's mama. Somebody put her out, she's stinkin' up the yard.
Hear that? No trucks. No dogs. No Hank on the radio. The whole goddamn world ended about a week back. You sorry sacks of shit slept through it.

Dead folks get up and bite. Bit folks die and get up. TV said it got loose from some Army lab up north, then the TV lady ate the weatherman live on the air. Best ratings that station ever had. Now the Army shoots whoever comes askin'.
So here's how this goes. I wrote y'all a list, 'cause none of you can hold three things in your head, and one of you can't hold his piss. Try not to eat it.
No, Cletus. No work Monday. Your boss is out by the highway, eatin' the mailman.
Wherever them beds go, I'll be along. Keep your hands to yourself and your eyes above the flannel, or I'll feed you your own balls with a fork. And I'll make you say grace first.
That wasn't Darryl, dipshit. That was his mama. Y'all been wavin' a beer at a dead woman for ten goddamn minutes, and she still looked more sober than you.
Lurleen. Two hollers over. You've met me, shit-for-brains. You tried to dance with me on the Fourth of July. Twice. Once with the truck.

'Cause everybody else I know is dead, shootin', or Dale. My brother's out there somewhere, dumb as a sack of hammers. Till I find him, y'all are the last idiots I got, and that should scare the shit out of every one of us.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_list_: It's on the list, Cletus. I wrote it down so I wouldn't have to say it twice. If you can't read, lick it, I don't give a shit.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_moved: Well. It's a hole, but it's your hole. Smells like a dead man's socks and a bad decision. I'll take the corner where I can see the door. And y'all can quit starin' at my knot, it's load-bearin'.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_night: You ain't made it through a night yet, not sober. Sleep one off in your own bed, and if you hear somethin' scratchin' at the door, that's Mr. Henderson wantin' his bed back. Come mornin', I got somethin' for you.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_radio: Darryl's old radio's still sittin' in the cabin. I've been hearin' a voice on it, some smug asshole. Go see if there's anybody left to talk to who ain't you. God knows I'd pay for it.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_ready: This is where that fat son of a bitch keeps comin' back to, every night. Smell it? You ready? Once it starts, it don't stop, and it sure as shit don't care who's cryin'.
Let's go kill that fat fuck.
Then get your backs to somethin' and listen. You hear that? That's the wall. Try not to piss yourselves till it's through it.
Then quit standin' around where it eats, you're makin' it easy.
So that radio asshole knows where folks are holed up. Go find some. They got walls, they know how to work metal, and right now y'all don't know which end of a furnace is the hot one. I watched one of you check.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_scrap: So now you can melt shit. Copper first, then iron. Bring home eight bars of iron and I'll show you what a skillet's really for. Hint: it ain't eggs, and it involves your head.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_swing: You can't fight nothin' with a beer can, unless you're plannin' to bore 'em to death. Cabin's got a crafting table. Make a stone sword, and if you don't cut your own dick off, I'll show you what else you can put nails in.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.lurleen_zombi: Time you learned. Hit 'em in the head, it's the only part they ain't usin'. Hell, same goes for you. Don't let three get around you. They get fast in the dark, and they hear loud shit from a long way off. Go put down five.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_later.m: ...think about it, man. We went to the Moon, what, six times? Then we just fuckin' stopped. Why'd we stop? Somebody told us to stop. I'm just askin' questions. Hold on, I think I shit in the tank.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_show.al: If you can hear this, you ain't alone, bro. Get to one of those. They got walls. They got beds. They got a guy named Earl. Nobody's said anything good about Earl.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_show.ba: ...and we're back. This is The Bunker Experience, comin' to you live from my bunker, day eleven of whatever the fuck this is. No guests today. My guests all got eaten. One of 'em during the ad read.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_show.pl: Anyway. People are out there. I'm gettin' calls. Earl's Salvage, up north. Gas-N-Guns out west. Some tents they call Camp Tarp, out east. A busted rig down south. I'm told it smells like a dead trucker, 'cause it's got one.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_show.sp: This episode is brought to you by nobody, 'cause they're all dead. Use code DEAD for nothin' off. Stay hydrated, you beautiful pieces of meat.
story.wallis_ultimate.talk.radio_show.ta: I got a year of elk jerky down here, I got a sensory deprivation tank, I got a crate of hair foam that ain't done shit, and I got questions, man. Have you ever really looked at a zombie? Like, really looked? I did. It shit itself and kept walkin'. That's discipline, bro.
story.wallis_ultimate.transmission.dusk: Sun's goin' down, shitheads. If y'all ain't under a roof by now, I'll see you at the funeral. There won't be a funeral. There'll be a zombie wearin' your hat.
story.wallis_ultimate.transmission.home: Oh, that's where we're livin'? Jesus wept. Fine, I'm on my way. Don't touch nothin', and whoever's been shittin' in the corner can stop.
story.wallis_ultimate.transmission.horde: They're comin', a whole goddamn mess of 'em! Get somewhere you can hold, right fuckin' now, and if you gotta shit yourself, do it walkin'!
story.wallis_ultimate.transmission.respa: Welcome back, Cletus. You left all your shit in a hole with your name on it. Go get it before somethin' wipes its ass with it.
story.wallis_ultimate.transmission.safe_: Y'all found folks? Holy shit. Tell Earl that crooked old bastard still owes me for the still parts. Then watch how they work metal. You might learn somethin', for the first time since birth.
